To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the soil solarization, twelve different non-host crops and bio-fumigation with six non-host crops were highly effective in controlling collar and white root rot diseases of apple.
the combination of soil solarization, non-host crops, bio-fumigants and oil cakes are highly effective against collar root and white root rot diseases of apple.
soil solarization, mustard, cabbage, mustard oil cake and neem oil cake are effective against collar rot of apple.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation and selection of effective non-host crops, bio-fumigants and oil cakes against collar rot and white rot diseases of apple.

development and evaluation of non-host crops, bio-fumigants (whole plant mulching) and oil cakes as eco-friendly alternatives to chemical fumigants and soil solarization in management of soil borne diseases.
the development of an effective integrated approach for controlling collar rot and root rots of apple by combining soil solarization with non-host crops, biofumigation and oil cakes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the combined use of soil solarization, bio-fumigration and oil cakes would be a very useful tool for management of collar rot and root root diseases in apple orchards.
soil solarization, mustard and cabbage crops and oil cakes (mustard, neem) can be used effectively in controlling collar and root rot diseases in apple.

soil solarization and non-host crops (mustard and cabbage), bio-fumigation and oil cakes (mustard cake and neem cakes) could be used as effective management practices against collar rot and white rot diseases in apple.

soil solarization, non-host and bio-fumigation crops and oil cakes can be used effectively against collar rot and white rot diseases of apple.
